text: REPLAY COURT FEASIBILITY PROVED 2026-08-31, read-only and with no repository edits. I exported exact main e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a to /private/tmp, overlaid only docs-site/examples from exact docs candidate 76c62e738a2579d6598fccf3ac19266c60480e20, and used a temporary sbt setting on LocalProject("fixturesJVM") Compile unmanagedSourceDirectories to compile all eight public examples together. All compiled. I then ran docsprobe.inspectSource, modelAStory, representRecall, useEmbeddings, alignAndInterpret, summarizeRecall, scoreInterview, and saveModel and byte-compared each child stdout against its archived output file. Result: 8 of 8 exact matches, zero diffs. This proves the requested executable-docs gate can be implemented without a new sbt module or dependency: export exact candidate, overlay/locate docs examples, temporarily inject them into fixturesJVM, compile once, run a manifest mapping main class to output file, compare stdout byte-for-byte, then run the separate Astro checks. Keep sbt log/stderr outside the captured child stdout: an archive has no .git, so sbt-git emitted non-fatal not-a-git-repository stderr while the build and comparisons passed. A future gate must fail on any compile error, missing manifest entry, nonzero main exit, or output diff.
